U13 Grand Prix East

Four clubs. Six games. One photo.

Sunday 4 October 2026 · Korsgadehallen · Talata Basketball

Our U13s spent Sunday morning at Korsgadehallen for the U13 Grand Prix East. Four clubs, six games and a lot of basketball.

When the last game finished, players and coaches from all four clubs lined up for one photo together. That is the picture at the top of this page.

Thank you

Thank you to Falcon, Hørsholm and Ørestad Gorillas for the games and the good spirit on and off the court. And thank you to the Talata families who came to cheer.

The day in photos

All 11 photos are in the club gallery. The next U13 games, dates and halls are on the games page.

U13 trains every week. First session free.

Bring indoor shoes and a water bottle. We do the rest.
